scope: Theorem 3.1 (Supported rational descent) of the manuscript “Positivity of Serre's Intersection Multiplicity” (preprints/Positivity-of-Serres-Intersection-Multiplicity-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 193 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 7985cfbc11547cf6), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 10. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let A be a commutative Noetherian Z(p)-algebra of finite Krull dimension, let J ⊂ A be an ideal containing p, and let H be a connective associative A-algebra with central A-action. Let T be a finite commutative A-algebra with an action of a finite group G over A. Suppose that Spec T → Spec A is surjective and that G acts transitively on the points of every geometric fiber. Then pullback induces an equivalence KJ (H)Q ≃ KJ (H ⊗L A T)Q hG . (3.1) In particular, the map KJ 0 (H) ⊗ Q −→ KJ 0 (H ⊗L A T) ⊗ Q G (3.2) is surjective.
